presentation.description: Hunt through the boundary between the world and its shadows, passing through obstacles as you charge a visible enemy. An action point spent on a successful at-will attack can send you straight into another charge, while a brutal follow-up blow grants temporary vitality. Shadow packmates flank enemies alongside your companions, and your later gifts let you spend a healing surge to move through solid barriers or leave lingering necrotic and poisonous wounds with every melee hit.

presentation.description:
A feral howl heralds the arrival of your packmates, who slip around your foes to aid you and your allies.

DAILY / MINOR

Ranged 10

Effect: You conjure up to five shadow pack members in unoccupied squares within range that are adjacent to one or more enemies. The pack members last until the end of your next turn. Pack members can flank with you and your allies. As a move action, you can move any or all pack members up to 6 squares each.

Sustain Minor: The pack members persist until the end of your next turn.
